t: This is the Westminster Scholars War Memorial, also called the Crimea and Indian Mutiny Memorial, put up in 1861. It remembers nineteen former pupils of Westminster School: ten who died in the Crimean War and nine in the Indian Mutiny. George Gilbert Scott designed it in High Victorian Gothic style while he was Surveyor of the Fabric of Westminster Abbey. Look for the figures it depicts: Saint George, Edward the Confessor, Henry the Third, Elizabeth the First and Queen Victoria, who link the school to a long royal and national story.
